sections.title: 1. Personal data controller
paragraphs: The controller of personal data is a natural person, owner and administrator of the shkoli.bg website, established in the Republic of Bulgaria.
For questions related to personal data processing, you can contact us at: info@shkoli.bg

sections.title: 2. What personal data we process
paragraphs: When using the website, we may process the following personal data:
bullets: email address
name
username
profile picture (avatar), if voluntarily provided by the user
technical data (IP address, device and browser information, security logs)

sections.title: 3. Purposes of processing
paragraphs: We process personal data for the following purposes:
bullets: creating and managing user accounts
identity verification and account security
sending service-related system emails (e.g. account confirmation, password change, or password recovery)
improving the functionality, security, and quality of the website
analyzing website usage and detecting technical issues

sections.title: 4. Legal basis for processing
paragraphs: Personal data is processed on the following legal bases:
bullets: performance of a contract - to provide the service and manage the user account
legitimate interest - for security, prevention of abuse, and improvement of the service
consent - when the user voluntarily provides additional data (e.g. profile picture)

sections.title: 5. Email communication
paragraphs: The website does not send marketing or promotional emails.
Email messages are sent only when technically necessary for the service, such as:
bullets: account confirmation
password recovery or password change
closingParagraphs: These emails are an integral part of the service and cannot be opted out of.

sections.title: 6. Recipients and third parties
paragraphs: To provide the service, we use external providers that may process personal data on our behalf, including:
bullets: service analytics and improvement tools (Google Analytics, Hotjar)
error monitoring and diagnostics (Sentry)
closingParagraphs: Some of these providers may be established outside the European Union. In such cases, appropriate safeguards are applied in accordance with applicable data protection laws.

sections.title: 7. Cookies and similar technologies
paragraphs: The website uses technologies for storing information in the browser (including cookies, local storage, and session storage), which are necessary for the proper operation of the service, security, and usage analytics.
Additional information about the cookies and technologies used will be provided on the cookies page.

sections.title: 8. Retention period
paragraphs: Personal data is stored:
bullets: for as long as the user account exists
or as long as necessary to fulfill the purposes for which the data was collected
or until a valid deletion request is submitted, unless the law requires a longer retention period

sections.title: 9. User rights
paragraphs: Each user has the right:
bullets: to access their personal data
to correct inaccurate data
to erase their personal data
to restrict or object to processing
to submit a complaint to the Commission for Personal Data Protection
closingParagraphs: Requests may be submitted to: info@shkoli.bg

sections.title: 10. Policy changes
paragraphs: This policy may be updated. All changes will be published on this page with an updated date.
